claims.statement: For every finite ordinary tree T and natural p with x(T)+2<=p and 3p<2alpha(T)+1, the complete sum over original leaves v with Delta_p(T-v)<0 of Delta_(p-1)(T-{v,s_v})-Delta_(p-1)(T-N_T[s_v]) is nonpositive.
claims.scope: Exact lower-region ordinary-tree aggregate from SOLUTION-CONTRACT.md, with the fixed original strict selector and one summand per original leaf.
claims.reason: The first-descent count yields a conditional selected-tag deficit budget, but its marked occupancy transfer antecedent is not established universally.

claims.statement: For an eligible T,p, if the total actual addability over the selector-tagged independent (p-1)-sets in the H_v graphs is at most their total count times the mean actual addability of independent x(T)-sets in T, then the complete selected aggregate is nonpositive.
claims.scope: Conditional theorem for the exact fixed F(T,p), H_v and W_v; every original leaf is separately tagged. The premise is not claimed universally.
claims.reason: Double counting gives the strict earlier-layer mean bound <x+1<=p-1. Substitution into the tagged bipartite deficit identity gives the complete-sum inequality, including the Q=0 case.

limitations: The universal marked occupancy transfer inequality remains open.
The work proves a conditional bridge only and does not settle the primary claim.
No exhaustive computation or external literature result is claimed.
